name: BrightSmile Dental Clinic
tagline: Gentle, modern dentistry for the whole family
description: BrightSmile Dental Clinic provides preventive, cosmetic and family dentistry in a calm, clinic-grade environment. From routine check-ups to smile makeovers, the team explains every option before anything is done.

assistant.greeting: Hello, I'm Pearl, the BrightSmile Dental assistant. I can tell you about our treatments and timings, and help you send a booking enquiry to the clinic on WhatsApp.
assistant.systemGuidance: This is a dental clinic. Never give medical or dental diagnoses, treatment recommendations for a specific condition, or pain-management advice — always say the dentist will assess during the consultation. Emergency pain or trauma should be sent to the WhatsApp/phone handoff promptly.
quickPrompts: What's involved in a teeth whitening visit?
I have a toothache — what should I do?
I'd like to book a consultation

services.name: Check-up & Consultation
services.description: A full oral examination with the dentist, including an assessment of your teeth and gums and advice on next steps.

services.name: Professional Cleaning (Scaling)
services.description: Removal of plaque and tartar to keep gums healthy and breath fresh.

services.name: Tooth-Coloured Fillings
services.description: Composite fillings for cavities, matched to your natural tooth shade.

services.name: Root Canal Treatment
services.description: Modern single-sitting options where clinically suitable, to save an infected tooth.

services.name: Teeth Whitening
services.description: In-clinic whitening performed after a dental assessment, for a brighter smile.

services.name: Braces & Clear Aligners
services.description: Orthodontic consultation to discuss braces or aligner options for crooked or crowded teeth.

services.name: Kids Dentistry
services.description: Patient, child-friendly check-ups, sealants and fillings in a separate kids' chair.

faqs.question: Do I need an appointment?
faqs.answer: Yes for most treatments — send a booking enquiry and the clinic will confirm a time. Genuine dental emergencies are seen as early as possible; call or WhatsApp the clinic straight away.

faqs.question: What are your opening hours?
faqs.answer: We are open 9:30 AM – 7:30 PM Monday to Saturday, and 10:00 AM – 1:00 PM on Sunday.

faqs.question: Where are you located?
faqs.answer: We're on MG Road, Bengaluru, opposite the metro exit, with lift access to the clinic.

faqs.question: Does it hurt? I'm nervous about the dentist.
faqs.answer: The team works at your pace and explains each step. Numbing is available for injections — mention any anxiety when you enquire so the dentist can plan a comfortable visit.

faqs.question: Do you accept insurance or provide bills?
faqs.answer: Itemised bills are provided for every treatment, and the clinic can discuss applicable insurance paperwork when you enquire.

faqs.question: How often should I get a check-up?
faqs.answer: Most dentists recommend a routine check-up and cleaning every six months; your dentist will advise what suits you after examining your teeth.

booking.disclaimer: This is an enquiry, not a confirmed appointment. The clinic will confirm your slot and any preparation needed on WhatsApp.

whatsapp.defaultMessage: Hi BrightSmile Dental! I'd like to ask about booking an appointment.

guardrails: Never diagnose conditions or recommend specific treatment for a user's symptoms; the dentist assesses in person.
Never quote prices or state appointment availability.
